portable_principle: Compiler-resolved facts can make narrow leads and move plans honest, but human intent and project conventions remain explicit inputs rather than inferred authority.

final_outcomes.incomplete_sweep: one-straggler option-field leads flow from resolved calls and Git trajectory into the existing human-verdict and triage workflow
final_outcomes.folder_reorganization: an explicit project convention can authorize a read-only internal-package move plan with current-module import impact and native verification obligations

shared_concepts: host Go discovery and minimum version
complete, partial, unsupported, and failed outcomes
kept_family_local: option-struct call grouping and Git trajectory
reuse_decision.next_abstraction_gate: Extract only a vendorable bootstrap/path primitive after one real repair must be applied to at least two installed consumers.

known_limits: incomplete-sweep is a human-review lead limited to direct project top-level functions and keyed struct literals
Git timestamps are trajectory evidence, not proof of intent
folder proposals require an explicit project convention and are restricted to internal packages in one module
framework convention inference, workspaces, cgo, external tests, nested modules, and execution of the move remain deferred
